description: This PHP file defines a custom exception class 'BadRequestException' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for API version 2. under the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Api\V2\Exception. It inherits from the base PHP Exception class and is used to represent HTTP 400 Bad Request errors.

classes.name: BadRequestException
classes.description: A custom exception class for handling HTTP 400 Bad Request errors in the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a default or provided error message, error code, and optional previous Throwable exception.
